design.games: first eight in committed ds-pro-v1 placement order, excluding Hajimi; all distinct openings; retain missing or failed as such. Hajimi remains a separate exposed example.
design.unit: One actual NEWLY PLANTED tree and its first uninterrupted ownership tenure, including harvest on its planting action through first loss, expiry or official horizon; no buyback. Primary self = ds-pro-v1, rival separate.
design.predictors: Only the NEW tree's observed cell and both rosters at action t before its planting. Enemy threat is the minimum 15x15 toroidal Manhattan distance to any opposing planter; bins [0,2],[3,5],[6,infinity),absent. Own screen is min distance to any friendly collector; mark within one step or farther/absent. Distances measure access, not successful defense. No hidden carbon, future actor positions or target command used as predictors; analyses condition on the fact that a tree was actually planted.
design.outcomes: Primary event = first tenure ends by hostile seizure and gross verified cash strictly below paid plant cost (1e-7 tolerance). Denominator = every plant in the pre-action bin. Secondary = unrepaid at any end and among those seized, net cash, coverage per map, step<200 vs >=200. Report primary split separately for friendly collector within one step. Counterexamples: earliest chronological self close-threat repaid and self far/absent-threat seized before repayment. Counts and per-map proportions are descriptive, not causal.

companion: The exposed Hajimi loss is recorded separately in tree_ownership.json.gz. It supplies no sample or label here.
interpretation: Across eight distinct earlier games, 11/325 self-plants were seized during their first tenure before repayment. The 0-2, 3-5 and 6+ distance risks are 3/44, 4/144 and 4/123. Actual repayment occurred on 38/44 near-threat plants. Friendly collectors within one step were associated with 0/40 such events versus 11/285 otherwise; this is a small, observational sample of planted cells. It supports collecting tenure and cash labels plus counterexamples on independent maps, not a fixed exclusion radius or an intervention-level return claim.
